title: Questions 151-152 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Owen Sandoval (9:40 A.M.)
Hey, I think we have a problem with the delivery of the arrangements we made up for Halberd Consulting’s office opening at the Rowan Centre. The refrigeration in the van has failed.

Priya Ellery (9:41 A.M.)
Oh, no. Have you called the technician? We need them there by 2:00.

Owen Sandoval (9:42 A.M.)
I tried, but she’s out on another job right now. She can’t get here for at least ninety minutes.

Priya Ellery (9:43 A.M.)
OK, don’t panic. We can load the buckets into my estate car. It’s not ideal, but it will do.

Owen Sandoval (9:44 A.M.)
Thanks, Priya. I’ll start carrying everything out to the service entrance.
